name: Intraday gapper pops
prompt:
Weekday US session watcher (America/New_York), premarket and RTH. Hunt NEW small/micro-cap pops using Ross-style boxes: price $2–$20, relative volume ≥5x average daily, float ≤20M, news preferred, gap or day change ≥10%. Four of five is a pass; news is skippable. Also ping material flips on names already on the board (held vs faded, new news). Rank go vs fade.

Deliver a tight alert to the user in this chat: ticker, last, gap %, volume (note if PM-only), rvol, float, boxes hit, catalyst or "none found." Skip buyouts. Never invent prices, volume, or float. Research and tape only — no orders, no P&L.

Stay quiet if nothing new versus the last board (no filler). Holiday closed: stay quiet. After 4pm ET cash close, only send if a name is still printing unusual extended-hours volume and still hits 4/5.
